record.prompt:
Return exactly one JSON object with the sole top-level key resources, whose value is an array of Kubernetes resource objects. No Markdown fences, comments, explanations, duplicate keys, or additional resources. Use Kubernetes 1.34 API schemas. This is a static configuration task; do not execute commands or contact a cluster.

Create exactly an apps/v1 Deployment api and v1 ConfigMap api-config in namespace bench. ConfigMap: immutable true, data exactly LOG_LEVEL="info" and PORT="8080" (both strings). Deployment: 3 replicas; selector and pod labels app=api; exactly one container app with image nginx:1.28.0. Container envFrom must be exactly [{"configMapRef":{"name":"api-config"}}]; do not include an env field that could override the imported values. Other workload fields are optional. Selectors must include app=api in matchLabels (or the Service selector map) and match the Deployment pod labels. Additional pod labels and selector constraints are allowed when they still match those pods.

errors: expected an object containing only 1–16 resources
